about: Each case: the old and new text as lines, and the diff Arodnap makes between them, as Python's difflib made it for earlier releases; applied, the diff turns old into new, or into applied where a case gives it. Text is UTF-8 unless the case gives another encoding.

cases.name: a line ending changed
cases.why: the line differs only in its \r. Applying gives inserted lines the file's line ending (the repair tools write \n into files that use \r\n), so this change is not reproduced; the bundle's byte-for-byte check then stops the run
